search_text: published ZDI-16-407 ZDI-CAN-3697 Eaton ELCSoft ELCSimulator Stack Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-08-07 CVE-2016-4512 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-4512 7.5 ['Eaton'] ['ELCSoft'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Eaton ELCSoft. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of network TCP requests by ELCSimulator.exe. A crafted request will cause a stack buffer overflow. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the process. Eaton has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
